statement: Luminous Menagerie is a major patch of proper endgame content, giving new content and multiplicative boosts for pushing old content.
Expects Luminous Menagerie to work something like Equinox and the Button, going by what he has seen.
Over 20 new additions: new artifact, coral kid upgrades, clan works upgrades, new vial, new coral reef fish; around 26 listed.
Five new doublers: summoning doublers, black stars for gaming pellets, organic labels for exotic market, and one for each research game.
Six small jellyfish each with own system, including one that helps read Spelunking pages and another that auto uses the ladle.
This is the end of World 7 part two; next expansion brings new maps, monsters and skill three.
A new in-game event comes shortly after launch, plus a huge quality of life update like a hat rack but not for hats.
Assumes the QoL is an attire rack; worries all attire is pay-to-win pack content and hopes free-to-play players get something earnable.
New artifact tier means going back to the library and updating talents; guesses first half is easy and the latter half takes forever.
Extra artifact chance sources like the World 2 ballot gain value; the ballot was a crutch before but now worth voting for.
New coral kid upgrades are coming; some have already been teased.
New Mussolini upgrades actually refer to Clam Works in World 7, giving a reason to progress it more; he dislikes it.
For Clam Works the best classes are RG and what sounds like RGAC; V-man has some uses too.
New vial in alchemy should be relatively easy to pick up; resource needed is unknown.
New coral reef fish to rescue is the first since early World 7 and gives another upgrade requiring coral.
Summoning doublers double the efficacy of summoning stuff and can be buffed in some way, maybe via a tier upgrade.
Assumes black stars for gaming pellets are the names of doublers in the gaming pellet area.
Tier list for exotic market doublers is simple: better exotic and free exotic, plus land rank database ones.
Hopes the research doublers are resettable like summoning doublers, unlike Exalts and Prismas, otherwise easy to break your account.
Six more jellyfish presumably make up the Luminous Menagerie part; details to be figured out later.
Auto ladle is quality of life; reading Spelunking pages automatically wasn't necessary and he prefers manual to see buffed pages.
Jelly Operator was the last patch on September 19th; this patch was intended as a weekly and is now a month later.
Make sure you can access the final map of World 7's Trench by finishing the branch leading right on the map.
Orange guy's coral will be expensive; hopes there is a way to progressively spend saved coral since many players have millions.
Coral kid has a singularity mode toggle only seen as a toggle; unclear how it works for divinity, maybe like Spelunky manic mode.
Spoiler shows a square tile doubler boosting the tile its cog sits on, and a new tiny cog likely tier 11 plus.
Unsure whether new tiers need combining or are just higher tiers; chances of tier nine or ten are already very low.
Thinks the spoiler image shows two things; the bottom-left glow is just the death bringer helmet.
Auto read vote came with extra bonuses making it more effective than manual reading, so it serves a purpose.
Menagerie has button/equinox style challenges; god rank 20 is a second or third pip, so lower god rank challenges likely come first.
Holo trunk appears to be the doubler; unsure if exactly double or whether the double can be buffed.
New currency is spent on upgrades like cooking speed; progressing areas of the account gives the currency or boosts its generation.
Possibly the double of currency for minehead; minehead still needs more income sources because prices scale too much.
Challenge: achieve 200 endless summoning victories, four pips along.
Challenge: reach 1000 worship levels; he has neglected worship.
Challenge: reach god rank 20, the second pip, so ranks one and zero presumably lower.
Challenge: level up turkey meal to 140.
Challenge: reach a worker class, probably eight or nine in clam works, text cut off.
Right-hand upgrades are likely spelunk auto read, a new tier of sailing artifacts, and the coral kid divinity mechanic.
Pink jellyfish gives plus one shell and boosts Lumi gains; requires significant cash in a new coin type.
Scourge is unknown, maybe a new minigame mechanic.
Crucible mode unknown; the sword looks like an altered bravery sword, best guess bravery, probably a World 7 thing.
Silver jellyfish relates to opals: possibly a fragment multiplier and a multiplier to auto recycle.
Entire system accessible via World 7 town for a few weeks; after that you need to reach the proper map by beating the ancient fish.
Silver jellyfish auto recycle doesn't require interacting with the jellyfish, so fragments can be farmed without reaching the final map.
Pre-stacking obol recycle fragments isn't worth it because a number will multiply dramatically, increasing fragments anyway.
For new artifacts, do the easy left-side ones, then jump ahead to the talent book; maybe late game islands, everything from the edge is amazing.
A divinity ballot week is on now; pre-stack characters' divinity so you have points for the new coral kid upgrades.
Unsure whether new Mussolini upgrades means new upgrade types or new worker comp; Mussolini is the one who yells at you.
New vial is nothing special; new coral reef fish is somewhere on the World 7 map to grab.
World 6 summoning doublers are activated in summoning; one note gives an extra 17% multiplier to doublers.
He has an infographic on best gaming pellet nodes; the new one is pretty awful for jelly operator; Prisma will be up there.
Doubling Prisma is juicy, with an extra 14 50 percent mentioned.
High exalted stamp is really amazing; mega nut good; ribbon chance strong; extra gold food drop monster statue; extra tokens for rad niche but good.
Prioritize gaming feed-back nodes: sprout growth and multiplier, spelunking power, artifact chance, extra dust and pallet luck; critters not so much.
In exotic market, gravel pounds is a strong spelunking power multiplier and sap surge is also strong; out of farming bonuses these are best.
Better exotic and free exotic are automatic grabs; centrific is pretty good; data digging may add four or five land rank database levels.
Land rank database gives extra stealth for ninja twins, drop rate and damage; all stat is an automatic purchase, as are stalk values especially stalk value three.
Research doublers cover minehead, sushi station and jelly operator. For minehead, numbers, grid expansion, better numbers and base damage one and two are strong.
Minehead strategy revolves around final round fury, so double that; doubling boom blocker would be great but some nodes can't be doubled.
Multipliers are stronger than additives, crowns are strong; later ones are too expensive even for players at 30 to 40 million per hour.
He is number one in jelly operator DPS despite just copying people ahead of him, apparently.
Cell mutation is much stronger than thought; reaching level five and six is a big deal and worth saving for; cell destructions are good.
Virus cell is insanely good; push towards it after cell adaptation. Cell desolation could be a buy as optimizers recommend.
For sushi station he is unsure; probably not fuel capacity, but anything that contributes to cash gain and speed.
Faster fuel generation isn't needed; maybe just books for sushi. New fish will be expensive but many have lots of coral.
Patch comes out in two days at 6 pm UK, which is 7 pm Central Europe and 11 am US West Coast.
